# French legal APIs for AI agents (x402, USDC on Base)

Two HTTP APIs. POST JSON, pay USDC on Base, get the result. Offline compute. No INSEE/Sirene fetch. No scrape.

## E-invoice calendar + L441-10 + checksums — $0.01

Base: https://fr-legal-kit.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev
Docs: https://fr-legal-kit.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev/llms.txt
Manifest: https://fr-legal-kit.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev/.well-known/x402.json

POST /v1/einvoice-who
{"size":"micro"|"pme"|"eti"|"ge"}
France 2026-09-01: all VAT-liable firms must RECEIVE e-invoices. GE/ETI must EMIT. PME/micro emit 2027-09-01.

POST /v1/late-penalties
{"amount_ttc":1200,"days_late":18,"bce_refi_pct":2.4}

## Invoice/quote legal mention blocks — $0.02

Base: https://fr-invoice-mentions.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev
Docs: https://fr-invoice-mentions.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev/llms.txt
